mapper.insert: insert into user(openid, name, phone, sex, id_number, avatar, status, total_order_count, total_amount, last_login_time, create_time) VALUES (#{openid},#{name},#{phone},#{sex},#{idNumber},#{avatar},#{status},#{totalOrderCount},#{totalAmount},#{lastLoginTime},#{createTime})
mapper.select: select u.*, (select count(1) from member_comment mc where mc.user_id = u.id) as commentCount, (select count(1) from member_favorite mf where mf.user_id = u.id) as favoriteCount from user u where u.id = #{id}

select u.*, (select count(1) from member_comment mc where mc.user_id = u.id) as commentCount, (select count(1) from member_favorite mf where mf.user_id = u.id) as favoriteCount from user u
and u.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and u.phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%')
and u.status = #{status}
order by u.create_time desc
mapper.update: update user set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
